_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Fear/greed mid-50s and flat 30d BTC keep the coil intact; no breaker has fired so the statistically honest next rung is a drift into Complacency only if range holds.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicitly calls Complacency/HOLD; narrative only confirms current Anxiety with no forward stance
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound, fear/greed holds ~45-55, and neither ETF flows nor exchange netflow trends into a decisive price break
next_move.invalidated_if: Range break with fear/greed leaving mid-40s–mid-50s, confirmed by sustained positive ETF flows (up) or netflow extremes plus fear/greed through 40 (down)
